_comment: Single source of truth for the personal homepage. Changing `atm26Url` moves every ATM26 link on the site; the token __ATM26_URL__ in index.html and data/news.json is replaced at build time (see build.mjs). `goatcounterCode` is the GoatCounter site code (https://<code>.goatcounter.com). When it is empty, the tracking snippet is removed and visitor statistics stay hidden; see README.md.
